newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: SNB provided liquidity, satisfied w/franc levels.
newsitem.headline: SNB provided liquidity, satisfied w/franc levels.

text.p: Swiss National Bank chief economist Georg Rich said the central bank added liquidity to the money market this morning to counter tightness caused by technical factors.
Rich also told Reuters the Swiss franc had reached an acceptable level against the German mark and the U.S. dollar.
Asked about short-term money market rates, which currently are around two percent, Rich said: "There is a certain shortage of liquidity and we have tried to counter that."
Tomorrow/next money in recent days has also been relatively tight. It was quoted today at 2.0 to 2-1/4 percent.
Traders have said the tightness was probably due to demand for funds before the end of the liquidity period on March 28 and before the end of the first quarter.
Rich said the tightness in the market was due to technical factors.
Asked about the franc's exchange rate, Rich said it was acceptable against the mark, "but also acceptable against the dollar, whereas the ranges are quite wide." -- Zurich Editorial +41 1 631 7340
